On July 1, 2023, police conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle that had run a red light in La Crosse, WI. The driver claimed he was on his way to pick up two friends from Riverfest. However, officers detected the smell of alcohol coming from him. He procrastinated and became uncooperative when asked to perform Standardized Field Sobriety Tests (SFSTs). After being informed that he was under arrest, the situation only escalated further for the rest of the night.
